tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineYiddish: דער קלוגער כתב-קוקער פאר שיעורים און חידושי תורה
releaseTitle: v1.1.2 — High-Contrast Installer & Streamlined Studio UX Overhaul
description: Ksav Kooker (כתב קוקער) v1.1.2 completely resolves washed-out text in the Windows Setup Wizard with high-contrast typography, restores the 3D logo emblem in the installer, adds a native Windows Menu Bar, and overhauls the main studio toolbar into a streamlined, uncluttered layout with stacked Scan, Export, and Profile dropdowns.
features: High-Contrast Windows Installer: Restored high-contrast slate typography on clean white pages, eliminating washed-out text, with clear navigation and verified 3D emblem rendering.
Native Windows Menu Bar: Added full standard File, Scan & OCR, Learning & Profiles, View, Language, and Help menus with keyboard shortcuts.
Streamlined Stacked Toolbar: Consolidated sprawling buttons into clean, intuitive dropdowns: '⚡ Scan ▾' (Current/All), '📄 Export ▾' (Word/Text), and a unified Profile button.

Fixed Font & Icon Clipping: Completely fixed button padding and dimensions across sidebar and viewer controls (+ Add, Delete, ↻, ↺, ✨ Ink Enhancer, ⛶ Fit, +, −) to eliminate truncated labels and square boxes.
Categorized Torah Abbreviations Menu: Replaced sprawled abbreviation buttons with quick favorites plus a categorized dropdown for Seforim/Rishonim and Talmudic terminology.
English Default Interface: Clean English interface by default with instant one-click toggle to Hebrew at runtime.
Multi-User Handwriting Profiles: Dedicated isolated learning memory banks for different scribes and students.
Multi-Profile Stacking: Combine rules from multiple people simultaneously during OCR scans.
One-Click Backup & Restore: Instant timestamped backups, safe restores, and colleague rule merging.
100% Offline & Roaming Profile Compatible: Runs locally on CPU with zero internet connection required.
